title: The 1932 railway bridge over the River Benue at Makurdi
verified: Commons title and categories (Makurdi; Bridges in Nigeria) name it the 1932 rail bridge; photo shows the steel-truss Old Bridge (not the concrete New Bridge). Uploader's own work, Wiki Loves Africa 2021.
